findings.evidence: template/scripts/run_test_groups.py:227–235 enables the gate solely because a committed .managed-task.json exists; line 314 invokes it before any group executes. This candidate uses private_lineage_handle, whose resolver in template/scripts/managed_task.py:1746–1749 requires exact local task state. Both .managed-task-state.json and .claude/ are git-ignored, and .github/workflows/ci.yml:19–65 performs a fresh checkout and invokes run_test_groups.py without provisioning them. A read-only invocation of require_early_routing_gate(Path.cwd()) in this candidate checkout reproduced TestGroupError: private managed-task lineage could not be verified. Consequently the required validate job cannot run its unit tests for this active candidate.
findings.summary: The new test gate blocks CI for active managed candidates because fresh checkouts lack machine-local routing and task state.
